article.title: Learning Through Teaching
article.content: One effective way to master a topic is to teach it to someone else. Teaching forces you to organize ideas, identify gaps, and explain concepts clearly. If you cannot explain a point simply, you may not fully understand it yet. This method works even when you study alone. Imagine you are giving a short lesson, speak out loud, and use examples from daily life. The process turns passive reading into active thinking.
article.translation: 掌握一个主题的有效方法之一是把它讲给别人听。教学会迫使你整理思路、发现漏洞，并清晰表达概念。如果你无法把一个观点简单说明，往往意味着你还没完全理解。即使独自学习，这个方法也有效。你可以想象自己在做一段小课堂，开口讲解并结合生活例子。这个过程会把被动阅读转化为主动思考。

questions.prompt: What can teaching help a learner discover?
options: A way to avoid organising ideas
questions.explanation: 教学需要整理思路并识别理解漏洞。

questions.prompt: How can someone use this method while alone?
options: Imagine a lesson and explain aloud
questions.explanation: 作者建议独学时想象自己在讲课，开口讲解并用生活例子。

questions.prompt: What does difficulty explaining a point simply suggest?
options: The learner may not fully understand it
questions.explanation: “you may not fully understand it yet”明确说明了这种困难的含义。
